mapper.select: select SUM(IFNULL(CASE WHEN (instr('C1,T18', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) /**C1:产品认购,T18:认购确认**/ WHEN (instr('C3', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) /**C3:份额强增**/ /**添加红利转投金额 C10 leipeng 20180926**/ WHEN (instr('C2,C10,T04,T05', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) /**C2:产品申购,T04:申购,T05:申购确认**/ WHEN (instr('C4,T06,T19,T24', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 /**C4:产品赎回,T06:赎回,T19:赎回确认,T24:赎回到账**/ WHEN (instr('C6', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 /**C6:份额强减**/ WHEN (instr('C5,T07', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 /**C5:产品到期,T07:到期**/ WHEN (instr('', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 /**提前终止份额,待添加**/ WHEN cp.vdate = d.settle_date THEN 0 /**起息日等于确认日，为0**/ ELSE 0 END,0)) as shareLastDay /** 上一日份额：对应产品在对应日期的认购份额+强增份额+申购份额-赎回份额-强减份额-到期份额-提前终止份额 **/ from FIN_PRODUCT cp left join FIN_PRODUCT scp on scp.p_finprod_id = cp.finprod_id inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL d on cp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id or scp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id where cp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and d.SETTLE_DATE <= (STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')-1)

select sum(IFNULL(d.INT_AMT,0)) as intAmt /** 获取产品利息 **/ from fin_product cp left join FIN_PRODUCT scp on scp.p_finprod_id = cp.finprod_id inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL d on cp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id where cp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and d.SETTLE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')

select SUM(IFNULL(CASE WHEN (instr('C1,T18', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) /**C1:产品认购,T18:认购确认**/ WHEN (instr('C3', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) /**C3:份额强增**/ /**添加红利转投金额 C10 leipeng 20180926**/ WHEN (instr('C2,C10,T04,T05', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) /**C2:产品申购,T04:申购,T05:申购确认**/ WHEN (instr('C4,T06,T19,T24', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 /**C4:产品赎回,T06:赎回,T19:赎回确认,T24:赎回到账**/ WHEN (instr('C6', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 /**C6:份额强减**/ WHEN (instr('C5,T07', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 /**C5:产品到期,T07:到期**/ WHEN (instr('', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 /**提前终止份额,待添加**/ ELSE 0 END,0)) as shareRemainderDay /** 当日剩余份额：对应产品在对应日期的认购份额+强增份额+申购份额-赎回份额-强减份额-到期份额-提前终止份额 **/ from FIN_PRODUCT cp left join FIN_PRODUCT scp on scp.p_finprod_id = cp.finprod_id inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL d on cp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id or scp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id where cp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and d.SETTLE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and d.finprod_type in ('F16','F18','F22','F26')
